speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand this neonate is presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth; to begin my assessment, can you tell me the mother's history regarding any infections, fever, or unusual vaginal discharge during labor?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE). Given the history of chorioamnionitis, low Apgar scores, and acute onset of seizures with lethargy, I will now order an Urgent MRI Brain and a CBC with Blood Culture to rule out sepsis.
